scope: Seven complete LLVM file reviews; implementation transfer candidates, not a completed new Ink solver.

files.llvm/lib/Transforms/Scalar/SCCP.cpp: Full pass orchestration: initialize entry/arguments, solve and resolve unresolved values before rewrites, remove infeasible edges through dominator updater, preserve only analyses actually maintained.
files.llvm/include/llvm/Analysis/SparsePropaga: Full generic solver: pluggable lattice keys/transfer/merge, monotone convergence, value/block worklists, feasible-edge PHI revisits, conservative untracked states and 64-incoming precision cap.
files.llvm/include/llvm/Transforms/Utils/SCCPS: Full API: predicate context, value/struct/argument/return/global tracking, specialization invalidation, provenance restrictions and explicit unresolved-value completion.
files.llvm/lib/Transforms/Utils/SCCPSolver.cpp: Full 91447-byte implementation in eight contiguous ranges: deduplicated instruction scheduling, first block visitation suppression, hidden predicate/overflow dependencies, transitively invalidated specialized calls, bounded widening, exact reachability repair, field summaries, constant substitution/effect constraints, range simplification and metadata/provenance boundaries.
files.llvm/test/Transforms/SCCP/2002-05-02-Mis: Complete historical regression; every initial block instruction must be visited, not only the first changed instruction. Read, not executed.
files.llvm/test/Transforms/SCCP/2002-05-20-Mis: Complete historical regression; later feasible backedge must invalidate initial constant PHI inference. Read, not executed.
files.llvm/test/Transforms/SCCP/2002-05-21-Inv: Complete historical regression; nested loop convergence must not wrongly delete the reachable return. Read, not executed.

insights.llvm: SparsePropagation permits a reusable scheduling engine while clients define keys, transfer functions and joins.
insights.ink: Potential Ink scheduling machinery can remain general; algorithm-specific equalities and transfer proposals remain database knowledge, with normal proof replay.

insights.llvm: SCCPInstVisitor queues instruction users only when lattice state changes, using SmallSetVector.
insights.ink: Assess dependency-indexed discovery instead of rescanning every site for every state. Measure proposal/evaluation counts and compile time; no runtime benefit assumed.

insights.llvm: Do not enqueue instructions in unvisited blocks or later than the current instruction in the initial walk. Earlier users and backedges still requeue.
insights.ink: A fact traversal needs explicit processed/pending state; blindly dropping repeat work can miss later instructions or loop dependencies.

insights.llvm: Newly feasible edges retrigger PHIs even if a destination block was already reachable.
insights.ink: Facts about branch-local values cannot be cached without branch/context identity. Future loop/fold summary joins must include every feasible path.

insights.llvm: Predicate constraints and extracted overflow flags add AdditionalUsers beyond ordinary operands.
insights.ink: A discovery dependency index must account for conditions, definitions, helper bodies and contract premises, not only surface operands.

insights.llvm: resetLatticeValueFor walks ordinary and additional users, including tracked returns, then resolves remaining unknowns.
insights.ink: After changing a helper body or accepted module prefix, invalidate dependent summaries. Existing exact prefix cache binding is necessary but is not an incremental solver.

insights.topic: Precision loss is the safe budget exit
insights.llvm: High-degree PHIs become overdefined; widening bounds range extensions by active inputs or fixed limits.
insights.ink: Future cyclic analysis must widen to unconstrained facts when its budget expires, not retain an optimistic constant or claim unreachable code.

insights.llvm: SCCP performs explicit unresolved-value completion before rewrites.
insights.ink: Ink cannot equate unfinished analysis, a missing fact, or unsupported semantics with an impossible execution path.

insights.llvm: Struct elements, incoming arguments and return values have separate lattice entries.
insights.ink: General checked function and record-field summaries can retain known fields when other fields are unconstrained; must bind exact body and call context.

insights.topic: Constant result does not erase effects
insights.llvm: Constant call substitution respects musttail/attachedcall and trivial deadness; implicit references are preserved.
insights.ink: Ink constant-result proposals must preserve effects, errors, ownership and evaluation count; known output alone cannot justify dropping a call.

insights.llvm: Inserted instructions receive full ranges when absent from old solver state.
insights.ink: Facts belong to exact expressions and context. New replacement nodes must not inherit facts by position or stale identity.

insights.llvm: Solver removes bounded masks, simplifies range checks, converts nonnegative signed operations and infers no-wrap regions.
insights.ink: Low-mask law already exists in Ink. Further signed/range transformations need ordinary conditional laws under Ink wrapping/conversion/error semantics; LLVM poison flags are not authority.

insights.llvm: LLVM uses attributes, metadata, undef/poison refinement and pointer provenance restrictions.
insights.ink: Do not import those assumptions as Ink facts. Fallible requires/ensures remain runtime validations; metadata remains untrusted. Pointer equality alone does not authorize owned-storage interchange.

ink_observation.status: Relevant existing implementation inspected; prior full-file review already recorded.
ink_observation.detail: analyse recursively recomputes facts; candidates invokes analyse again for conditions/operands/branches. Branch facts carry explicit scope; support is total Bool/U32/U64 only. Count repeated work and validate context-safe reuse before choosing changes.

limits: No LLVM executable tests run in this review.
Production publication recovery is a separate unfinished local change.
